M-TEST-RUNTIME-SHIMS.Purpose: Runtime-only UnityEngine/Verse shim assemblies (UnityEngine.CoreModule, UnityEngine.IMGUIModule, Assembly-CSharp) letting the core xunit suite execute FlexVerse.dll under .NET 10 without the game, plus the completeness gate that keeps them in sync.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: UnityShim: CoreModule surface — Rect/Vector2/Vector4/Color math, Object/Component/MonoBehaviour hierarchy, GameObject, Texture, Mathf, Debug, Time.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: ImGuShim: IMGUIModule surface — Event/EventType/EventModifiers, GUI, GUIStyle, GUIContent, GUIUtility, ScaleMode/FocusType.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: VerseShim: Assembly-CSharp surface — logging, GameFont/FloatRange, deterministic Text metrics, ButtonText recording and tooltip entrypoint.
Scope.SCP-IN-005: TextRenderingShim: TextRenderingModule identity for TextAnchor and FontStyle.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: ShimCompletenessTests: static memberref audit of FlexVerse.dll against the shim surface.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Compile-time identity of Unity/Verse types — owned by Krafs.Rimworld.Ref (compile-only reference).
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: In-game behavior — owned by the Pickle plane; shims are inert stubs, never game truth.

Principles.PRIN-001: Owners and signatures mirror real UnityEngine/Verse exactly (e.g. the Color→Vector4 conversion is owned by Color), so JIT binding succeeds under .NET 10.
Principles.PRIN-002: Shims are runtime-only: compile identity always comes from the Krafs reference assemblies.
Principles.PRIN-003: Shim drift fails loudly and centrally: the completeness gate names every missing member instead of scattering MissingMethodException across runtime tests.

Requirements.REQ-001: Every memberref of FlexVerse.dll targeting a shimmed assembly and a shimmed declaring type must resolve against the shim surface (name + parameter count).
Requirements.REQ-002: Declaring types that are not shimmed at all (game-plane only: Verse.Widgets, Verse.Text, ...) are explicitly skipped, not silently tolerated for shimmed types.
Requirements.REQ-003: Property accessors bind as methods: shim state exposed to FlexVerse must be properties (GUI.color, Time.deltaTime, GUIStyle.alignment, GUIStyleState.background), not fields, wherever the real engine declares properties.
Requirements.REQ-004: Shim GUIStyleState and GUIStyle copy construction support native TextField appearance fixtures but do not simulate actual caret, selection or IME behavior.

Inputs.IN-002: Shim assemblies from the test output directory.

Outputs.OUT-001: Pass/fail verdict listing every unresolved member.
